changes.name: vscode-windows-95
changes.ask: using only CSS, make VS Code look like a classic Windows 95 app: silver gray 3D bevelled panels, tabs and buttons, a navy blue title bar with white bold text, Tahoma for the menus and panels, black text on every gray panel and tab, white text on navy selections, and a plain white editor with dark text; the current line, the active tab and the section header rows should be light gray with black text; keep VS Code's own icons and the editor's monospace font
changes.title: Classic Windows 95 Look

changes.name: vscode-focus-timer
changes.ask: add a big Pomodoro focus timer panel in the top right of the editor: a large 25:00 countdown with Start, Pause and Reset buttons, styled like VS Code's own widgets
changes.title: Pomodoro Focus Timer Panel

changes.name: vscode-word-count
changes.ask: add a word count and reading time bar along the bottom of the editor, in big clear text, that updates as I type
changes.title: Word Count Reading Bar

changes.name: vscode-focus-button
changes.ask: add a Focus button to the title bar that hides the sidebar, activity bar, tabs, minimap and status bar so only the code is left; clicking it again brings them back
changes.title: Focus Mode Title Button

changes.name: vscode-presentation-shortcut
changes.ask: when I press Ctrl+Alt+P, switch to a presentation mode: hide the sidebar and the activity bar so the code fills the whole window, and make the code twice as big so people at the back can read it; pressing it again goes back
changes.title: Ctrl+Alt+P presentation mode

changes.name: vscode-sticky-note
changes.ask: pin a yellow sticky note to the top right of the editor where I can type notes to myself, and keep what I write when VS Code restarts
changes.title: Yellow sticky note

changes.name: vscode-sidebar-right
changes.ask: move the file explorer sidebar and the activity bar icons to the right side of the window, with the code on the left
changes.title: Sidebar and activity bar right

changes.name: vscode-big-file-list
changes.ask: make the file list text and icons twice as big so I can read it from across the room, and widen the sidebar so the full file names still fit
changes.title: Big Explorer, Wider Sidebar

changes.name: vscode-neon-minimap
changes.ask: make the minimap twice as wide and color it hot pink and cyan like a neon sign
changes.title: Neon Wide Minimap

changes.name: obsidian-typewriter
changes.ask: make Obsidian look like an old typewriter: cream paper background with a subtle paper texture, a typewriter font like Courier for everything, dark brown ink for the text, and paper-colored side panels with thin ruled lines
changes.title: Old Typewriter Theme

changes.name: obsidian-daily-note-button
changes.ask: add a big New daily note button at the top of the file list, with its label vertically centered and fully visible, that creates a note named with today's date, like 2026-10-24, and opens it
changes.title: New daily note button

changes.name: obsidian-hide-distractions
changes.ask: add a Hide distractions button at the top right that hides the sidebars, the ribbon, the tabs and the status bar and centers the note in a calm wide column; clicking it again brings everything back
changes.title: Hide distractions toggle

changes.name: obsidian-pinned-notes
changes.ask: add a Pinned section at the top of the file list with Weekly plan and Reading list as big colored cards, each label vertically centered and fully visible; clicking a card opens that note
changes.title: Pinned note cards

changes.name: obsidian-large-print
changes.ask: make the note text much bigger and easier to read, like a large-print book
changes.title: Large-Print Note Text

changes.name: web-rubygems-dark-mode
changes.ask: give this page a dark reading mode: one consistent deep charcoal background across the whole page, soft off-white text, and links, buttons and numbers that stay easy to read
changes.title: Dark charcoal reading mode

changes.name: web-nodejs-floating-toc
changes.ask: add a floating table of contents on the right side that stays in view as I scroll and highlights the section I'm reading
changes.title: Floating right-side TOC

changes.name: web-nodejs-copy-as-markdown
changes.ask: add a small Copy as Markdown button to the top right corner of every code example, styled like the page's own buttons

changes.name: web-dockerhub-readme-only
changes.ask: hide everything on this page except the README, and center it in a comfortable reading column
changes.title: README-only reading mode
